occupied.note: Screen only: 22–26°C, 40–65% RH and speed ≤0.25 m/s. No PMV/PPD claim; MRT, clothing and verified activity are missing.

assumptions: HVAC drawing was not attached: room shape, opening sizes and all equipment coordinates are provisional.
Occupied volume 7 × 5.78 × 2.9 m; 2.9–4.8 m ceiling void excluded.
Steady RANS k-epsilon, Boussinesq, constant dry-air density 1.2 kg/m³, atmospheric pressure 101325 Pa. Moisture is a dilute passive humidity-ratio scalar.
Adiabatic walls; no solar, envelope conduction, radiation, solid equipment or hood capture geometry.

People: distributed occupied-region source, 75 W sensible + 55 W latent/person by default; provisional split referenced to ASHRAE Fundamentals 2021 Ch.18, Table 1 standing/light work; walking slowly. Confirm activity and room-temperature correction.
Cooking sources are independently configurable per station; default zero because equipment schedules are missing. Hood OFF caps that opening; it does not switch cooking off.
FCUs use local momentum actuators and sensible UA cooling (nominal kW at 10 K difference); no added mass or dehumidification.

One provisional 0.9 × 2.11 m transfer doorway split into lower/upper face patches at quiescent adjacent-reservoir hydrostatic total pressure; inlet kinetic head included; net AND bidirectional flow solved, never prescribed.
First-order upwind on provisional coarse Cartesian mesh. Mesh-independence study and measured-data validation are not performed.
RH >100% is flagged: condensation is not modelled. Comfort criteria are a configurable-data screening proxy, not ASHRAE 55 certification.
